title: feat: an object's action layout per scope, pinned and more, set from the design mode (#36366)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XUZ1viPwnt3ZWuPpxejiN3)_
Fixes #36366
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #36630
ADR notes: carrier #36086 (seat posts them)

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在设计模式里点页头最右边的「页头按钮」，能把列表页和记录页的动作分成「固定」（最多三个，可拖动排序）和「更多」（也可排序），保存后所有成员看到的页头都跟着变；记录页的设置同样作用于侧边预览和手机底栏。
- 属于「运行界面的设计模式」专题，解决按钮多时挤掉记录名、管理员又改不了页头的问题。
- 设置错了，管理员在同一面板里改回或取消即可；对象不写这项设置时，页头和今天完全一样。
- 无。

## What changes

`actionLayout` is a new optional key on `ObjectSchema` and `ObjectExtensionSchema`, in the format of the maintainer's ruling (2026-11-22T14:50Z, quoted in release 7087101113: 「#36366 改成"列表"和"记录"两组，每组分"固定"和"更多"两段，等 #36363 合并后，卡标记为p1，剩余任务放回队列」) and seat rulings 7077698148 / 7080672229:

`actionLayout: { list?: Arm, record?: Arm }`, `Arm = { pinned: string[] (at most 3, required, may be []), more?: string[] }`.

- **spec** (`packages/spec/src/data/object-action-layout.ts`): the shape and its refusals at every door (more than three pinned, a name twice in one part or across both, a malformed name, a built-in the scope does not have), each with a named reason; the object form offers one JSON row per arm under Advanced. Generated artifacts regenerated (api-surface, export-origins, authorable-surface, dropped-refinements counts, references); liveness row `object/actionLayout` is `live`, drilled into `list` / `record` and each into `pinned` / `more`, citing the record header, the list header, the fold and the design mode.
- **objectql + metadata-protocol (patch round 2, M1)**: `actionLayout` is the third key of `CUSTOM_ARRANGEMENT_KEYS`, beside `fieldGroups` and `relatedLists` (ADR-0146 D10). Only the base's paired `.custom` package writes it on an `object_extension`; the one judge `judgeExtensionArrangement` refuses any other package's, each door in its own way: publish, restore and draft promotion answer `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400; marketplace install refuses the package body with `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 422; `os validate` and `os build` exit non-zero and print the row; the registry fold skips the key and leaves a note. The registry applies the pair's arms last, in `applyCustomArrangement`, by role, arm by arm. A manifest's `objectExtensions` entry now carries the key to the fold (`objectExtensionContribution` dropped it).
- **lint**: `validateObjectActionLayout` refuses, in `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`, a name in either part that is no action of the object or is not placed in the scope its arm arranges.
- **`@object-ui/types`**: `arrangedHeaderActions(actions, arm, scope)`, the one reader; `pinned` become buttons in pin order, the names `more` gives lead the overflow in that order, unnamed ones follow in their default order.
- **console**: the synthesized record header (record page, the side preview's embedded mount, the phone's bottom bar) and an authored `page:header` with `placedActions: true` read `actionLayout.record`; the list header reads `actionLayout.list` with `$import` / `$export`. Under the design mode, 「Header buttons」 at the end of the header opens a two-part panel (「Pinned to header」 at most 3, 「Other」 = More), both parts draggable, a dot moving an action between them, a fourth pin refused with a toast; the mode's Save writes the object's own package when writable, else the installed object's customization package's `object_extension`, through the one writer of an installed object's arrangement, `saveObjectExtensionArrangement` (patch round 3).
- **i18n**: `designMode.pins.*` in every hand-written locale, including the new `designMode.pins.stale` (names the arm sets that the scope no longer offers); zh-Hant regenerated. Object-form translations for the two arm rows in all 11 metadata-forms locales.

### 待审假设 (assumptions for review, shown to the maintainer, not ruled)

1. The key name `actionLayout`.
2. The `record` arm is a scope, not a page: the record header, the side preview and the phone bottom bar all read it.
3. An action the scope places that neither part names goes to the end of More, in its default order.
4. A hidden pinned action leaves its slot empty; no other action takes its place.
5. No arm (or no key) = today's drawing, exactly.
6. Among built-ins, only the list scope's `$import` / `$export` can be named, and only in `pinned`: one in `more` is refused with its reason (not pinned, the page still draws its own Import / Export menu). The record scope has none.
7. Only the base's paired `.custom` package writes `actionLayout` on an `object_extension`. Each arm it writes replaces the served arm for that scope whole, after every other layer (a tenant's arm for the same scope included); an arm it leaves out stays.
8. A `page:header` authored with its own `actions` list keeps that list; the design mode offers it no 「Header buttons」.
9. Save refuses: more than 3 pinned, a name in both parts, an unknown name, an action of the other scope (the last two at `os validate` and in the design mode's Save; see Acceptance notes for the server door).
10. Names the arm sets that the scope no longer offers are listed in the panel as left out and skipped by the reader.
11. With no list arm, the panel says "No button is pinned: every action is in More." while the bar end shows the page's Import / Export menu (`Import ▾`), and 「Other」 lists Import: for a built-in, 「Other」 means "in the page's Import / Export entries". The wording is kept as is.

Out of scope: #36494 (row menu and right-click), #36495 (the `locations` vocabulary), #36496 (the `selection` arm).

### Tests changed because the surface grew (named, each recounted by measurement, not by hand)

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts`: `object` 51 → 52.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/object-collapsed-sections-echo-decisions.test.ts`: leaves 119 → 125, `advanced` 106 → 112.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts`: positive control 760 → 763.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`: paired spans 127 → 131 and 127 / 127 / 0 → 131 / 131 / 0 (main's 127 after #36370, measured again after the merge).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/designModeHeaderPinsSave-36366.test.ts`: its `input` helper now types the pins as `ObjectPins` (the type-check read the old `string[]` shape as nine TS2353).
- The CLI transcripts in `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`, `deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`, `getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx` and `ui/react-pages.mdx`: author-time rules 76 → 77, as `check:docs-transcript-drift` derives.
- `packages/spec/src/compose-stacks-merge-collection-refusal.test.ts`, `packages/spec/src/compose-stacks-merge-config-object-refusal.test.ts`: `actionLayout` added to the config-object key list.

## Tests

**Patch round 3, head `8a85482aea`** (L2 delta S5, N4, N5; S1 waits on #36635 and is untouched).
- **Merge**: `origin/main` `6e643cc43e` merged in `d871e26fdb` with no conflict (it brings #36624's one writer and #36621's app-menu entry). `origin/main` `9c283a11bf` still merges cleanly.
- **S5, the L2-preferred route**: the installed-object branch of `saveObjectPins` now calls `saveObjectExtensionArrangement`, handing it only the composed `actionLayout`. That module's patch type is `{ [K in CustomArrangementKey]?: ExtensionArrangementValue... }`, a list for `fieldGroups` / `relatedLists` and `ObjectActionLayout` for `actionLayout`; its docblock names the header buttons as a caller. The writable-package branch, which writes the object itself, is unchanged. S3 holds: the composed value is the arms the stored extension holds with each changed arm replaced. New `designMode.pins.pairNotWritable` in the 11 locales (zh-Hant regenerated).
- **Pins** (`designModeHeaderPinsSave-36366.test.ts`, 13 tests): a pair the server answers not writable is refused after the ensure call and before any read or write; through the one writer the stored `relatedLists`, `fieldGroups` and held list arm are kept and the publish announces itself; the S3 pins and the call-order pins (now ensure, get, layered, save, publish) pass. Ablation: composing over no stored `actionLayout` turned 2 red (the S3 held-arm pin and the S5 kept-keys pin), restored blob equals HEAD's.
- **Docs and wording**: `actions.mdx` now reaches 「Header buttons」 through the app name at the top of the sidebar, then 「Edit app」. Changeset: `[]` pins none; the spec bullet names the built-in refusal in `more`; each door's own answer. `object.zod.ts`: the `actions` guidance and the comment above `membershipKeys` name `actionLayout` as a pair-only key beside `fieldGroups` and `relatedLists`.
- **Reruns**, all exit 0: closure build; `check:generated` (no drift); ui 16 files plus `packages/i18n/` (122 files / 2134 passed, 13 skipped); spec 101 files naming `ObjectExtensionSchema` or the guidance (6725 passed); spec typecheck; app-shell, components and i18n type-check; 23 gate families (i18n, docs, changeset, liveness, facade, nul-bytes and others). Lines in the seat file.

**Patch round 2, head `49a31750bc`** (L2 review M1, S2, S3, S4; the ADR-0085 §2 sentence and #36086 untouched). No merge: `origin/main` `d7411fa373` merges cleanly.

- **M1, chosen semantics: per-arm replacement, the pair only, applied last.** Measured first: every door already reads `CUSTOM_ARRANGEMENT_KEYS` through the one judge, so the mechanism applies as is. The five doors and where they call it:
  1. publish, restore and draft promotion of an `object_extension`: `objectExtensionItemRefusal` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts`;
  2. `os validate`: `packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts`;
  3. `os build`: `packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts` (both CLI doors through `packages/cli/src/utils/extension-arrangement.ts`);
  4. marketplace install: `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`;
  5. the registry fold: `applyCustomArrangement` in `packages/objectql/src/registry-custom-arrangement.ts`, run last in `foldExtendersOntoDefinition`, skips a non-pair package's key and names it in a warning.
  The round-1 priority fold (`foldExtensionActionLayout`, `actionLayout` in `OBJECT_FOLD_SCALAR_KEYS`) is removed; `registry.ts` is back at main's 6426 lines.
- **Pins replacing "partner 250 beats pair 150"**: a partner's `object_extension` save with `actionLayout` answers `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400, one issue at `actionLayout`, nothing stored or served, the pair's save served (`packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-arrangement.test.ts`); in the registry, partner at 250 against the pair at 150, and a partner registered after the pair, both serve the pair's arm (`registry-extension-action-layout.test.ts`); the judge names the path and prescribes the action's own `locations` and `order` (`protocol-extension-arrangement.test.ts`).
- **S2**: `actionLayout` no longer yields to a tenant: the pair applies last, per arm, so a tenant's arm for another scope stays and the pair's arm wins for its own scope (two pins).
- **S3**: the design-mode Save writes only the arms whose staged value differs from the served one, merged into the arms the document already holds; nothing changed means no call (three pins).
- **S4**: chosen to refuse: the schema refuses a `$` built-in in `more` with its reason, the Save never writes one there, and the `pinned` describe, the form help (11 locales) and the docs say the list page still draws its own Import / Export menu; the `more: ['$import']` examples are gone.
- Reruns, all `command-exit 0`: spec test 974 / 29634 and typecheck; metadata-protocol test 365 passed, 9 skipped; objectql test 634 / 14360; lint 228 / 9474; platform-objects 125 / 2126; typecheck of metadata-protocol, objectql, lint, cli; cli unit extension-arrangement files 3 / 48; cloud-connection install arrangement 1 / 5; ui 36366 files 6 / 59; `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check; `check:generated --fix` regenerated `content/docs/references/**` and rechecked green. Gate families this round's files touch: 25 run, exit 0; `check:i18n-coverage` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (example apps unbuilt), NOT MEASURED locally, CI runs it. Lines in the seat file `objectstack-seat2/36366-gates-ran.txt`.
- **Ablation, the per-arm fold**: `ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `layout = { ...(layout ?? running), [scope]` with `{}` as the base (blob `67155de2c30c` → `6f6b1a29855b`); 2 failed / 11 passed (arm by arm; the S2 tenant arm kept); restored blob equals HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Files beyond the claim (round 2)**: `packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.ts`, `packages/spec/src/data/object-extension-arrangement.test.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-extension-arrangement.ts` and its test, `packages/objectql/src/registry-custom-arrangement.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/engine-registration.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-arrangement.test.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/extension-arrangement.ts` (comment only).

## Acceptance notes

- **Server save door.** It refuses only a malformed arrangement. Live reading on the CRM example (dev server, admin): `PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/crm_opportunity?package=com.example.crm.custom` with `actionLayout.list.pinned` naming 4 actions answered `422` `INVALID_METADATA`. The message read: "`actionLayout.list.pinned` names 4 actions; at most 3 are drawn as buttons, and every other action goes to 「More」. Keep the first 3 and move the rest to `more`."
  - A name that is no action of the object, or one not placed in the arm's scope, is refused only by `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` (`object-action-layout-unknown` / `-not-placed`) and by the design mode's Save.
  - The lint rule is CLI only: the runtime snapshot carries no stack `actions`, so an action bound by `objectName` would read as unknown there.
- **Door-level code+status.** The schema refusals are pinned in `packages/spec` (`object-action-layout.test.ts`); the door's `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 is the live reading above. Since patch round 2 the writer refusal is pinned at the save door with `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 (`protocol-custom-arrangement.test.ts`).
- **`registry.ts` is a facade at its line ceiling.** Since patch round 2 the fold lives in `registry-custom-arrangement.ts`, and `registry.ts` differs from main only in one docblock line (6426, the ceiling not raised).
- **The CLI transcripts count 77 author-time rules.** The new lint rule is the 77th. `check:docs-transcript-drift` derives 77 for `validate` and `build`, and four transcripts that quoted 76 now say 77: `deployment/cli.mdx`, `deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`, `getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx`, `ui/react-pages.mdx`.
- **Live-run wording.** With no list arm, the panel's sentence and the bar's `Import ▾` menu: kept as is, listed as 待审假设 11.
- **Export was not offered on the CRM opportunity list in the live run** (that view has no export door), so the run pinned Import. The record scope was not run live: `crm_opportunity` declares no actions of its own. The record header, the side preview and the phone bar are covered by the unit tests below.
- **Merged with main, conflicts kept both sides.**
  - #36583 (now on main): `designMode.recordTabs` and this PR's `designMode.pins` are both kept in the 11 locales.
  - #36411 (now on main): `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` recounted by running it, 131.
  - #36612 (now on main): `ObjectViewPageBarActions` reads its Object settings path, then this PR's list arm. `exportDoor` is `exportPinned ? undefined : barEnd?.exportDoor`, and `moreShown` is `!!objectSettingsPath || !!description || !!listFavorite || (ioInMore && (importInMenus || !!exportDoor))`.
- **Overlap with open PRs** (`overlap-check --branch=HEAD` at `ebd99fe0dd`, exit 1):
  - #36606 conflicts in `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`.
  - #36525 conflicts in `protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts` and `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts`.
  - Whichever lands second recounts. #36624, #36587, #36386 and origin/main merge cleanly.
- **Landing class.** The diff changes more than 3,000 lines, so under AGENTS.md §7(c) it lands like Tier H.
- **Owed outside this PR.** The ADR-0085 §2 and ADR-0146 D10 notes (`carrier: #36086`), and `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` (#36630).
- **Follow-up, outside this diff (N5).** The door comments in `packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts`, `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts` (step 8) still name only `fieldGroups`, `relatedLists` and `place`; the code reads `CUSTOM_ARRANGEMENT_KEYS` and already refuses `actionLayout`. Comment-only, carrier: the seat.
